newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel to release some frozen PLO funds.
newsitem.headline: Israel to release some frozen PLO funds.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu decided on Monday to release a portion of financial transfers to the Palestinian Authority which Israel froze after a double suicide bombing, Netanyahu's office said.
"It is correct, he will release some of the frozen funds," a spokeswoman at Netanyahu's office said.

Israel radio said Netanyahu had decided to free 30 percent of the millions of dollars in customs and tax transfers he held back after the July 30 attack killed 16 people, including the two suicide bombers.
The radio quoted Netanyahu's spokesman as saying Israel would release a portion of the funds because the Palestinian Authority had partially restored security cooperation with the Jewish state.
The United States has criticised Netanyahu for freezing the financial transfers.
Israel has said it would release the funds and ease other sanctions it imposed after the bombing in parallel with Palestinian President Yasser Arafat's steps on security.
